A '''cargo tug''' was any vehicle used to transport cargo modules. Variants included [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles used for the transportation of cargo around hangar bays and military bases for loading onto [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], and [[Realspace/Legends|space]] tugs used for hauling cargo among [[Space station/Legends|space stations]].

==Characteristics==
Ground-base cargo tugs were designed to operate with rotating cargo-pod holders: quad carousels that could hold sixteen cargo modules. Two cargo tugs carried one carousel between them, allowing a transport's loading arm to lift its cargo from the rack and into position on the ship.

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] employed many cargo tugs in their bases on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where they were used to load and unload [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]].

The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outpost [[Pellezara station]] routinely used cargo tugs to move containers. The Datches, proprietors of Pellezara, included souped up tugs in the flight shows they performed for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] waiting for their [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to be serviced.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> The [[Hauler-2 cargo tug|Hauler-2]] was a line produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].
